steps.text: Uniform circular motion has constant speed but changing velocity, so it is accelerating.
Angular velocity ω = Δθ/Δt; v = ωr.
Centripetal acceleration a = v²/r = rω², always directed toward the centre.
Centripetal force F = mv²/r = mrω² is a resultant force, not a new kind of force.
At the centre, acceleration is perpendicular to velocity at every instant.
Banking and bends: the horizontal component of the normal contact force provides the centripetal force.
